results.headline: Arrow Announces IC-6 Well Results
results.key_quote: The multi-zone quality of the Icaco discovery, and its commensurate production rates, have surpassed initial expectations
results.summary: Arrow reported record production exceeding 6,000 BOE/D, surpassing initial expectations for the Icaco discovery. results.headline: Interim Trading Statement
results.key_quote: Trading within the Company's managed pubs and hotels was below expectations during the first half of the year...Performance within the national wholesale channel was below expectations...Within Retail, the Company has started to see encouraging evidence that targeted investment can improve returns and outperform the market.
results.summary: Adnams reported mixed results for H1 2026. Revenue declined to £27.4m from £30.1m YoY, largely due to anticipated pub disposals. Key negatives: managed pubs/hotels traded below expectations in H1 (though showed improvement in July with 3.3% like-for-like revenue growth and 10% profit growth); national wholesale channel performance was below expectations. Key positives: retail segment outperforming market with five-fold profitability increase post-store relocation; supermarket trading outperforming the wider beer market; Ghost Ship brand outperforming ale category by 2.1%; operating expenses reduced by over £2m; interest costs halved. Overall, some operational challenges were offset by positive retail developments and cost control.
